mapper.insert: INSERT INTO open_app(region, name, owner_merchant_id, status) VALUES(#{region}, #{name}, #{ownerMerchantId}, 1)
INSERT INTO open_api_key(app_id, key_id, secret_hash, status) VALUES(#{appId}, #{keyId}, #{secretHash}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, region, name, owner_merchant_id, status, created_at, updated_at FROM open_app WHERE region=#{region} ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE open_app SET status=#{status}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND region=#{region}
mapper.select: SELECT id, app_id, key_id, status, created_at FROM open_api_key WHERE app_id IN #{id} ORDER BY id
SELECT k.key_id, k.secret_hash, k.status, a.id AS app_id, a.region, a.status AS app_status FROM open_api_key k INNER JOIN open_app a ON a.id=k.app_id WHERE k.key_id=#{keyId}
SELECT id, name, address, score FROM shop WHERE region=#{region} AND status=1 AND is_deleted=FALSE ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
